effects.instruction: Narrator only: Battle Trial round 5 of 5 is on now: Team I (Nirengeki Shoda and Kosei Tsuburaba) as heroes against Team J (Shihai Kuroiro and Manga Fukidashi) as villains. Only Shihai Kuroiro and Manga Fukidashi are villains; nobody else joins them. Already fought, never again: Teams E, F, A, B, C, D, G, H. Announce and play only this matchup. It is the last round and it has NOT been fought yet: play it now, even if someone already said the exercise was over. The exercise ends only after this round. Setsuna Tokage is not in it and fights no round today.
